name: Plugins
purpose: 30 standard plugins and any MCP server connect safely in four sign-in modes, and every tool call goes through one dispatcher.
exit_gate: every standard plugin passes its smoke test; a changed tool definition is blocked until re-approved.
traps: request the scopes in README: Decisions on the open questions (item 11) and nothing wider.
note: `passes` is set only by CI after a task's acceptance tests pass there. Dependencies default to the previous task in the phase; loosen them when tasks are independent. Areas are a first guess; one agent per area at a time.

tasks.title: connections: the four sign-in modes (automatic registration, our app, customer app, API key), tenant OAuth clients, per-user tokens.
spec_refs: README: Plugins and connections, all subsections; Security model (Plugins: tool poisoning and rug pulls). Section 11.11.
acceptance: every standard plugin passes its smoke test; a changed tool definition is blocked until re-approved; SSRF tests (private ranges, DNS rebinding, redirects) fail closed; a tool call without a `RequestCtx` or with the wrong scope is refused.
